title: Probe Evasion Stress-Test: Measuring How Quickly Fine-Tuning Breaks Activation Monitors
original_idea: Train activation probes on a small open-weights model, then apply incremental fine-tuning on unrelated tasks. Track probe performance to plot a fragility curve. Test whether model-generated training examples extend robustness.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly quantifies probe fragility, giving labs concrete guidance on maintenance intervals. Immediately actionable for deployed monitoring systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires probe training, then incremental fine-tuning of Gemma-2-9b or Llama-3-8b (large models needing significant GPU memory), tracking across multiple checkpoints. 30hrs is tight.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear structure: one model, incremental fine-tuning, probe accuracy at each checkpoint, fragility curve. Well-defined deliverable.
